component_treatment.source location: hashed exactly as it appears, no normalization

statement: Only the label component is normalized; the source location MUST be hashed as it appears.
note: For a decision node the source location and the label are both the record title, which makes this rule easy to miss: the same string enters the digest twice, once raw and once normalized. The title here carries a colon, a comma and hyphens, so the raw and normalized spellings differ visibly.
